notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, i hope you are all doing well.
Here's what's new in this update:

[b]- Leaderboard Rework: [/b]
[i]The leaderboard has been revamped to improve performance and tracking.[/i]
[b]- Improved Spike Visibility: [/b][i]
Spikes are now easier to spot, especially on darker backgrounds.[/i]
[b]- Shorter Minigames:[/b] [i]
All minigames have had their durations reduced for a quicker, more intense experience.[/i]
[b]- New Hard Mode:[/b] [i]
For a real challenge! You only get 1 life, the floor disappears faster, and obstacles spawn more frequently.[/i]

Jump back in and see if you can beat the new gamemode!
